Service.title: Service
Service.description: A bookable service (consultation, class, room rental) with a fixed duration. Referenced by Appointment.serviceId. Part of the bookings-service-catalog dependency surface; declared here so appointment creation can validate duration against the service.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this service for tenant isolation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

serviceId.description: Operator-assigned unique service identifier within the administration.
serviceId.title: Service ID

duration.description: Service duration in minutes. Appointment endTime - startTime must match this (within tolerance) per REQ-BCA-003.
duration.title: Duration

price.description: DEPRECATED - superseded by `basePrice` from the canonical bookings-service-catalog fragment. Retained only so pre-existing rows keep resolving; read sites fall back `basePrice ?? price`. Do not use in new seeds. Service price in the administration's currency. Informational in phase 1; payment is out of scope.
price.title: Price

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the price.
currency.title: Currency

Resource.title: Resource
Resource.description: A physical or virtual bookable resource (staff calendar, room, chair) with operational hours. Referenced by Appointment.resourceId. Part of the bookings-resource-calendar dependency surface; declared here so appointment creation can validate operational hours and detect double-booking.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this resource for tenant isolation.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

resourceId.description: Operator-assigned unique resource identifier within the administration.
resourceId.title: Resource ID

openingTime.description: Daily operational start time as HH:MM in UTC. Appointments before this are rejected per REQ-BCA-004. Null means no operational-hours restriction.
openingTime.title: Opening Time

closingTime.description: Daily operational end time as HH:MM in UTC. Appointments after this are rejected per REQ-BCA-004. Null means no operational-hours restriction.
closingTime.title: Closing Time

allowOverlap.description: When true, the double-booking check is skipped for this resource (e.g. a trainer coaching multiple people). Defaults to false (single-booking) per design open question 5.
allowOverlap.title: Allow Overlap

Appointment.title: Appointment
Appointment.description: A booked appointment linking a customer contact to a Service and Resource at a specific UTC time window. The single source of truth for the bookings create flow (admin, customer self-service, API) per bookings-create-appointment. Validation (duration match, double-booking, operational hours, customer eligibility) runs in the AppointmentGuard save precondition (ADR-031 exception path) per REQ-BCA-003/004/006.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this appointment for tenant isolation and IDOR-safe scoping.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

appointmentId.description: Unique appointment identifier within the administration.
appointmentId.title: Appointment ID

startTime.description: Appointment start time as ISO 8601 UTC per design D6.
startTime.title: Start Time

endTime.description: Appointment end time as ISO 8601 UTC. endTime - startTime must match Service.duration within tolerance per REQ-BCA-003.
endTime.title: End Time

customerId.description: FK to the customer contact record (Nextcloud contact / IManager-synced). A customer is a Nextcloud contact entity, not a bespoke schema, per fleet convention.
customerId.title: Customer ID

status.description: Appointment lifecycle status. Admin bookings create as confirmed; customer self-service bookings create as pending_confirmation per REQ-BCA-005.
status.title: Status

cancelledAt.description: Timestamp when the appointment was cancelled (set by phase-2 cancellation flow).
cancelledAt.title: Cancelled At

cancelledReason.description: Reason for cancellation (set by phase-2 cancellation flow).
cancelledReason.title: Cancelled Reason

pending_confirmation.label: Pending confirmation
pending_confirmation.description: Created via customer self-service; awaits admin approval or auto-confirmation.

confirmed.label: Confirmed
confirmed.description: Booked and confirmed. Admin bookings start here.

cancelled.label: Cancelled
cancelled.description: The appointment was cancelled (phase-2 flow). Remains queryable for audit.

confirm.label: Confirm appointment
confirm.description: Approve a pending customer self-service booking.

complete.label: Complete appointment
complete.description: Mark a confirmed appointment as having taken place.

cancel.label: Cancel appointment
cancel.description: Cancel a confirmed appointment (phase-2 cancellation flow owns the full rules).

cancelPending.label: Cancel pending appointment
cancelPending.description: Cancel an appointment that was never confirmed.
